6486.d: The coal truck mine (also known as Dwarven Outpost) is located north of the Fishing Guild and west of McGrubor's Wood.
6486.loc: North of the Fishing Guild, west of McGrubor's Wood

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring teleport to the Dwarven Outpost once the Dark Facet of Luck enchantment has been unlocked.
• Combat bracelet teleport option to 4. Ranging Guild then walk across the log balance (Agility shortcut, level 20 Agility required).
• Seers' Village lodestone to Seers' Village S then run west past McGrubor's Wood on the south side and Walk-across log balance (Agility shortcut, level 20 required).
• Ardougne lodestone to West Ardougne ALT + A then run north-west past the Fishing Guild

6588.d: Colossi Divination is a Divination-themed activity on Havenhythe which requires level 77 Divination and partial completion of Heralds of Crimson.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Home teleport to Wendlewick lodestone and take a canoe to either:
• Heathervein 5, then traverse the River crossing (63 Agility) and slippery stone (73 Agility).
• Linbog Village 6, head east then run north of Fenmoor until north-west of Shuruk-Ba.
• Use the stonevein amulet to teleport directly to Divine Fall. Requires charging 10 murals and claiming the amulet from Aurriel.
• Teleport to fairy ring DIQ and go north-west (must first be repaired with 5 bogwart mushrooms and requires 79 Agility to access).
• Teleport to fairy ring DLP to Amberfell and head east.
• Travel to the Moonrise Dig Site and head to Amberfell, then head east.
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick lodestone.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash), and either:
• #* Head north-east through Berylbrook or by traversing the stepping stones (72 Agility) to the Exalted Quarry, traverse the River crossing (63 Agility) next to the Heathervein canoe station and slippery stone (73 Agility).
• #* Head south-east through Berylbrook and Moonsylvar Wood, then head east and run north of Fenmoor until north-west of Shuruk-Ba.
